title: research(bit): bound numerical callback word lifetimes
body:
## Summary

PR2759 bounds primitive arithmetic scratch above all entry residents, leaving the retained numerical caller state unpriced. This supplies a source-bound component for PR2697's unchanged `Callback.weight` and initialized `Page.evaluate`.

```text
Callback.weight, above all entry residents
  <= 20490 additional residue Words
  <= 10 additional index Words, independent of depth

Initialized Page.evaluate, above unrelated borrowed state
  <= 36879 residue Words, including form/Ring/incoming Callback
  <= 23 index Words, including request coordinate in borrowed state
```

The written lifetime proof follows actual matrix, scalar and address allocations. Literal fixtures attain all four bounds separately. Only `research/selected-callback-word-liveness/` is added, with six byte-identical source modules, their complete notice, exact pins, proof, fixed receipt and registered replay. Serialized continuation contents remain a separate depth-dependent component.

## Task and overlap

Refined `supplier-boundary-audit`, scope `66632af6c86d34fb0fdc/numerical-callback-residents`, nonce `28f866f1c603b2000095dd8bbf1830f5`, priority revision5. Base main `936fac15b1b1b59dc5285c713a77f9f3c07b2906`. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18958443).

Scientific source is Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 at `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1`. PR2759 at `2fd8fbe0d2f57c4a8ebb7b7c9ae45df1fcf69be9` supplies the primitive scratch result and explicit next handoff. PR2758 at `ef041c010b32f037dddf2f67a96a53d435966746` covers serialized continuations. David Arias's PR2753 at `7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659` already supplies a deliberately coarser complete logical inventory. This sharpens one per-evaluator component and does not claim first complete reserve admission. The active physical-bank codec and independent ordered-child geometry audit in the same thread are complementary.

Submission refresh checked canonical main `8e22a9d9f621c72ab5b299061c2be4c7f638fd3c`, unchanged guidance/selection and unchanged inspected dependency heads. Complete metadata pagination covered715 open PRs and1402 Discussion records without warnings. This search excludes arbitrary code diffs and does not prove novelty.

## Evidence

- Before, a primitive scratch bound could not price retained current forms, callback constants or address Words. After, the exact source lifetime ledger instantiates those residents. A one-word-underbudget good-index/fallback-residue allowance rejects actual execution; omitting the retained Page form also rejects.
- Registered CPython3.12.15 replay passes23 literal fixtures and452 direct occupied-cell scans, including full64-dimensional preparations,128-dimensional residuals, mixed histories and binary depth four. Twelve optimized behavioral tests pass, including rollback, repeated requests, borrowed values/heads, source corruption, stale bytecode and typed-receipt controls.
- A separate read-only source/proof/checker review confirmed all seven exact exports and the lifetime formulas. It caught an initial-scan instrumentation cleanup edge; the fix and regression pass. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.
- Full registered replay passes both at the starting base and in a separate worktree at refreshed main, whose package runner changed during the session. Its updated workflow suite passes74 tests with seven skipped. Scoped Ruff diagnostics, metadata/pins, local links and staged-diff checks pass. Environment: macOS27.0.1 arm64, Python3.12.15, standard library.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-callback-word-liveness
```

The universal bound rests on the written source invariants. Finite q=3/q=5 specifications exercise the literal routines, without claiming selected-catalogue membership or the outer large-prime coupling. Page construction, other node/route residents, serialized input/control tapes, erased backing capacity, physical placement and complete reserve admission remain open. No selected GL64 Boolean payload, full caller/cold replay, supplier adoption or new kappa is claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Credit

Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml supplies the unchanged implementation and retained control/algebra/source/hosting lineage. His full source notice is preserved unchanged. Nick Petalas's PR2759/2758 and David Arias's PR2753 retain their separate component and logical-caller credit. New work is Apache-2.0; exact source attribution and the assistance disclosure are in TASK.json and the retained notice.

## Open next questions

The README and structured TASK.json name two bounded follow-ups: count current Page-construction and surrounding caller residents at actual overlap, then price the numerical-bank codec with templates, markers, erasure and cursor movement. The remaining lifetime inventory, physical lowering and selected H2 contracts are blockers.
